user_query: I'm planning a road trip with my friends and we need some entertainment. Fetch a random joke from the Chuck Norris API and a random fact about cats from another API. Also, provide me with the exchange rate between GBP and USD using the Currency Exchange API.

TaskList.description: Fetch a random joke from the Chuck Norris API to entertain friends during the road trip.
Fetch a random fact about cats from a facts API to add more fun to the trip.
Get the exchange rate between GBP and USD using the Currency Exchange API for budgeting purposes during the trip.
